newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgacom to sell about 200 property assets.
newsitem.headline: Belgacom to sell about 200 property assets.

text.p: Belgian state telephone company Belgacom SA said on Thursday it would sell about 200 surplus property assets.

"On the one hand it concerns buildings which are no longer used, entirely or partially, for reasons of business economics, and on the other hand properties for which the planned projects were scrapped," Belgacom said in a statement.
It said it appointed DTZ Debenham Winssinger as its exclusive adviser for the sale of the Belgian properties which include offices, holiday centres, hotels, houses and telephone exchanges.
Both Belgacom and Winssinger declined financial details but a source close to the deal put the total value of the properties at one to two billion Belgian francs ($30.4 and $60.8 million).
Belgacom is 49.9 percent owned by a consortium including Ameritech, Singapore Telecom, Tele Danmark and three Belgian groups.
